review_description: MaxisolarLocal business ownerExcellent customer serviceInstallation quick efficient and work site left clean.

MAXSOLAR was recommended to us by friends who have taken the solar plunge.  We were not disappointed.  In a sea of dodgy so called "professional installers" and salesmen, Matthew (owner & installer) was in another league altogether.Matthew was efficient, professional, easy to get along with, didn’t take shortcuts, excelled at problem solving and didn't stock any rubbish products.We are delighted with our solar installation (Seraphim panels, Fronius inverter, Fronius smart meter) all efficiently put into place on our two storey house at a fair price.  MAXSOLAR website www.maxsolar.com.au  will provide more information.   Highly recommended.
Unable to comment on system really as have had no results yet.  Currently waiting the 30 days that energex get to update my meters.  Nothing but rain and cloud since the system installed.
